answer: Divergent-Response Identity Challenge: each identity must answer a fresh random challenge derived from a shared public seed, and clones sharing state return identical answers, so colluders must run independent reasoning per clone. An honest agent forges one answer per epoch; a sybil operator pays full compute per fake identity, scaling cost linearly. A cedar-seeded challenge rotates each round, and a meadow checkpoint binds answers to prior divergence history, so reused clones get flagged.
